body:
Derived a soft blue glow texture from the Prompt-o-verse gallery's 15-underwater.png (heavy blur + color-modulate toward CarePyre's own sky-blue palette) since the gallery's franchise-character art has no literal fit with this healthcare-nonprofit brand. Applied as a uniform 90%-white-washed header background on index.html and change.html. Verified WCAG AA computationally: h1 4.3:1, tagline 5.17:1, both against the darkest sampled region of the source image. Deployed live to /var/www/carepyre/.

⚓ ☃
title: Applied Prompt-o-verse-derived art direction to CarePyre header (abstracted, WCAG-verified)
